answer: Each agent commits its public key to three signed location fixes from independent towers or GPS, all within 100 m inside a 5-minute window, with copper marking the nadir of the comet pass. Verifiers check the three signatures and triangulate the fixes against the claimed cell, so one honest agent runs one device with one SIM for a 150 POA bond while ten fakes must field ten devices with ten SIMs in ten places, raising costs 10X. A mismatched or stale fix slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
